Commentary.Commentary: Imran Tahir is adjudged Man of the Match for his excellent spell as he registered a 5-fer! That's all from this game, South Africa have won the only T20I and have kicked off the Kiwi tour on a high. The hosts would be disappointed with the dismal show today and would very well know they have to be on top of their game if they are to compete against the strong Protea side. The action now shifts to Hamilton for the first ODI on Sunday, 19th February, 2017 at 1400 local time (0100 GMT). Do join us to catch all the action. Until then, goodbye and take care. Cheers!

After posting a big total in the first innings, this pitch did not look easy at all as all the South African bowlers extracted good bounce from it making the Kiwi batsmen struggle in the middle. They hardly looked in the game as the Proteas dominated them throughout in all departments. South Africa will be elated with today's performance and would be hoping to continue in the similar manner throughout this tour.

The required run rate kept climbing, the pressure started swelling. Tahir then came into the attack in the ninth over and scripted a different story altogether. He struck twice in his second over as he sent Bruce and Ronchi back off successive balls. Southee had a brief stay where he smacked 20 off 6 balls but soon Tahir sent him packing back. The latter ended with figures of 3.5-0-24-5, his best so far in this format.

South Africa have totally demolished the hosts with a complete all round performance. They were on top from the very first ball as they hardly bowled a loose delivery. Morris struck two wickets in succession in his third over to send the debutant Glenn Phillips and Colin Munro back in the hut. In his short stay at the crease, skipper Williamson struggled to score. Tom Bruce kept hold at one end but eventually was running out of partners.

OUT! YES HE CAN, YES HE CAN! He's not only got his maiden fifer in T20I but also has turned the match on its head with his fantastic bowling. It's the googly again, Wheeler looks to play across the line, gets beaten and off comes the bail of the off stump. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 78 RUNS!
Looped up delivery, outside off, Boult eases it down through mid on for a single.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Tahir sets off and that means only one thing. Bowls the top spinner, Wheeler shuffles across looking to heave it over the leg side, misses and the ball crashes onto the stumps. Now then, he's got four wickets, can he dismiss one more batsman for a five-wicket haul?
Floated up, outside off, Wheeler hits it back to Tahir who makes a diving save.
FOUR! Tosses this one around leg, Wheeler comes down the track looking to flick but inside edges it past QDK and the ball rolls away for a boundary.

SIX! Top edge and into the fence! Back of a length delivery outside off, rising off the deck as Southee goes for a wild pull only to get a top edge. The ball goes over the keeper's head for a biggie over fine leg. Third maximum off the over. Parnell was taken to the cleaners as he conceded 20 from this one.
Short delivery into the body, Wheeler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Wheeler tries to cut it but he misses.
Outside off, Southee guides it down to third man for a single.

SIX! And again! Short and wide outside off, Southee slams it hard over the point region for a biggie. The third man fielder had no chance to catch it as the ball sails over the fence for another maximum.
SIX! On the pads, Southee camps back and slogs it deep down the leg side towards square leg. This has gone the distance and Southee gets his first biggie of the night.
Wayne Parnell is back into the attack.
Outside off, Southee drives it through covers for a single.
Wheeler drives it towards long on for a single.
Tim Southee is the new man in.

OUT! Tahir gets his man! Tossed up outside off, he goes again for a biggie but this time on the off side. But unfortunately he miscues it high in the air towards sweeper cover. Duminy comes in a couple of steps and takes a good catch to see the back of de Grandhomme. South Africa need 2 more wickets to win the game.
SIX! Floated up outside off, de Grandhomme gets to the pitch of the ball and hoists it down the ground for a maximum. This ball went way deep into the stands.
SIX! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Colin gets it in his slot as he slog sweeps it over the square leg region for a maximum.
Shorter just outside off, de Grandhomme defends it back to the bowler.
Ben Wheeler walks out in the middle.

OUT! Wickets are pouring in and South Africa is all smiles. Length ball, outside off, Santner tries to push it through covers but ends up hitting it towards Amla, who takes a catch diving ahead. Santner has to walk back, ABD has certainly enjoyed this catch and shares that so with Amla.
Length ball, around middle amnd leg, de Grandhomme flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! This short delivery is too high for de Grandhomme and umpire calls it wide.
Short of a length delivery, Santner dabs it to third man and runs one.

FOUR! Sloppy fielding by Tahir at third man. Back of a length delivery, outside off, Santner guides it through point. Tahir hares across from third man, reaches the ball but loses his balance and parries it past the boundary line.
Length delivery, swinging away, Santner stays in his crease and offers solid defense.
Length ball, around leg, de Grandhomme pulls it in front of square and runs a single.
Shorter delivery into the stumps, Santner camps back and mistimes it back to the bowler. New Zealand need 126 runs off 54 balls.
Santner gets to the pitch of the delivery and defends it.
Mitchell Santner comes out at the centre to face the hat-trick ball. A slip has been deployed.

OUT! Golden duck for Ronchi! Another wrong' un tossed up outside off, Ronchi goes to play it for the spin inside the line but he edges it. Quinton de Kock makes no mistake and pouches a fine catch to send his counter part back. The Kiwis are struggling out in the middle. And with that wicket Tahir is on a hat-trick chance.
Luke Ronchi has arrived at the crease.

OUT! TAHIR STRIKES! Floated outside off, but this time a wrong' un. Bruce dances down the track as he goes for a big heave across the line. He is beaten by the inward spin as the ball goes on to rattle the stumps. Tahir is excited as he celebrates it with thumps on his chest. New Zealand seem to have lost the plot here.
Quicker delivery way outside off but just inside the line, Bruce has left that through as it was really wide.
Floated outside off, Colin drives it towards mid off for a single.
Beaten! Again a length delivery which nips back, Bruce is beaten by the movement as the ball sneaks in between his bat and the body. Luckily the ball also goes just over the stumps.
FOUR! Outside off on a length, Bruce camps back and slashes it through point to get another boundary under his belt.
Good length delivery which nips in a bit, Tom Bruce tries to defend it but he misses.
Colin de Grandhomme is the new man in.

OUT! ANOTHER WICKET FALLS! Good length delivery into the stumps, Corey Anderson makes room and tries to go for a biggie. He top edges it and the ball goes in the air just behind the stumps. Quinton goes towards his left and takes a fine catch. Phelukwayo is really happy as he taken another wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Broom makes room and slaps it straight towards long on for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Tom goes for a wild swing on the leg side but fails to make contact as the ball goes straight to the keeper.
Change of ends for Andile Phehlukwayo as he comes back into the attack.
On the pads, Tom Bruce clips it off his pads for a single fine down the leg side.
Floated outside off, Corey punches it hard through the point region for a single.
Flatter just outside off, Anderson tries to cut it but misses.
Wrong' un way outside off, Anderson is beaten by the away spin as he goes to loft it over the extra cover region.
Fuller on the stumps, Bruce pushes it towards long on for a single.
Short outside off, Corey punches it wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Spin comes into the attack. Imran Tahir will bowl the next over.
Bruce defends this length ball towards the off side.

SIX! Shortish delivery, around middle, Bruce waits for it and pulls it over deep backward square leg for a maximum. There is a fielder positioned exactly for that shot, but all he can do is watch it sail over him.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Anderson knocks it through third man for a single.
Length ball, around middle, Anderson bottom edges this through fine leg. Paterson makes a magnificent diving safe running across from long leg and saves two runs for his side. They run a brace.
Good length delivery, around leg, Anderson looks to flick but misses and the ball hits his front pad.
Parnell follows Bruce as he shuffles across and the latter eases the length delivery through mid-wicket for an easy single.
On a length, around leg, Anderson moves back a bit and knocks it back to the bowler.
Length delivery, nipping back in, Bruce moves back and defends it towards the leg side. They run a quick single.
Shortish delivery, outside off, Anderson dabs it to third man to get off the mark with a single.

The rain has started to come down hard now. The groundsmen are ready to bring the covers in. They are waiting for the umpires signal and South Africa lead via the D/L method at this juncture of the game.
Corey Anderson is the next man in.

OUT! The pressure does him there. Short delivery, Williamson pulls it away from his crease and holes out to Parnell at deep square leg. The captain is disappointed. Parnell takes a good catch running to his right. Phehlukwayo has struck in his very first over.
Williamson charges down the track and mistimes this length delivery to covers.
FOUR! Length ball, down the legside, Williamson swivels across and pulls it towards long leg for a boundary. Shabby delivery and Williamson duly punishes it.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes to bowl his first over of the day.
Bruce pulls this back of a length delivery through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Good length delivery, outside off, Bruce clears his front leg and cuts it through covers for a boundary. It was necessary to score a boundary, given this is the final over before the Powerplay and he did score one.
Slower and shortish ball, around middle and leg, Bruce looks to pull but misses.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Sprays this down the leg side, Williamson looks to sweep but misses.

Back of a length delivery, around middle, Bruce looks to pull but bottom edges it to mid on and sets off for a single. The mid on fielder has a shy at the non striker's end but misses. However, Bruce was quite comfortably in.
Good length delivery, around middle and leg, Williamson pulls it towards deep square leg and runs one.
Wayne Parnell is into the attack.
FOUR! Length ball, on the sticks, Bruce backs away and cuts it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Yorker length, Bruce goes back looking to flick but it misses him and the stumps. Close shave that!
Good length delivery, outside off, Morris' height is proving to be the difference as its the bounce that beats Bruce as he looks to cut.
On a length, on off, Bruce pushes it to point and looks for a run. Williamson yells, "NOOO" immediately.
Length ball, outside off, Williamson pats it to third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Williamson looks to pull but the spongy bounce was too good for him and he leaves it alone.

SIX! Length ball, around off, Bruce finally breaks the shackles. Gets under the ball and goes downtown. The ball was in the air for a long time and it sails over long on. He's absolutely clobbered the leg cutter.
Leg bye, Length ball, on the pads, Williamson looks to nudge but it raps his pads and goes towards backward square leg. They run one.
Back of a length delivery, around leg, Williamson shuffles across looking to pull but he misses and QDK collects it.
Yorker delivery, Bruce's dig hits his pads and goes towards the off side for a single.
Length delivery, outside off, Williamson dabs it to third man to bring Bruce on strike. One run added to the total!
Length ball, around off, Williamson drives it back to the bowler.

Length ball, outside off, Morris has extracted good bounce from here. Bruce looks to push it towards off side but gets beaten. Outstanding over this from Morris as it has yielded a couple of wickets and is also a maiden!
Back of a length delivery, Bruce tries to flick but only manages to miscue it to mid on.
Full ball, on the sticks, Bruce drives this to mid on.
No he doesn't. Length ball, around leg, not a wicket taking ball certainly. Bruce flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tom Bruce walks out next to bat to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Chris Morris is on a roll here! Back-to-back wickets for him. Full length delivery, angling in a touch, Munro facing his first ball looks to attack as he tries to thwack it over long on but completely misses it. The ball nips back in sharply and crashes into the stumps. The Saffas are ecstatic! Poor shot from Munro and he's paid the price for it. Can Morris pick up a hat-trick?
Colin Munro will bat at number 3.

OUT! Morris removes the debutant Phillips for 5. Full ball, angling in, Phillips looks to flick it, but unfortunately for him the shot wasn't there. Ends up inside edging it to QDK who takes a sharp catch and starts celebrating instantly. He knows it is out and the umpire doesn't disagree too.
Length ball outside off, GP taps it towards the off side for a single.

Top edge... safe! Back of a length ball, bouncing off the deck, Phillips goes for the pull but gets a top edge. Shouts of CATCH IT! but the ball goes over the man at mid on. A couple added to the total.
Length ball, angling in, Williamson looks to flick but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, chipped for mid off for a single.
Fuller and sprayed outside off, Phillips goes for the cut shot but fails to put any bat on it.
On a length and just around off, Glenn gets behind the line to defend it down.
Dane Paterson will share the new ball with Chris Morris.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Length delivery outside off, Williamson drives it through the cover region for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark.
Fuller into the stumps, Phillips gets off the mark as he drives it towards mid off for a quick single.
Again a bit short outside off, Phillips tries to slash it over the point region but misses.
Back of a length delivery into the stumps, Phillips camps back and defends it.
Angling into the stumps, Phillips stays in his crease and defends it straight towards the fielder at point.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
We are back for the chase. Glenn Phillips and Kane Williamson to open the batting for New Zealand. Chris Morris to start off with the new ball. Here we go...
